assets: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full playable top-down 2D pixel-art hub background, wide landscape 16:9, no UI. Original dark blue stone sanctuary for a blue cube roguelite, crisp detailed pixel art, nearly orthographic slight top-down perspective matching dungeon floor sprites. Broad EMPTY WALKABLE dark stone floor throughout center, low perimeter walls, subtle warm amber lanterns on outer walls, restrained cyan inlaid paths leading from center to a raised EMPTY circular portal dais at top center. Four small EMPTY circular station pads: left middle amber, right middle green, bottom left violet, bottom right warm amber. No characters, no portal itself, no furniture/obstacles in walkable space, no text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no watermark. Floor should remain low contrast so small player is readable. Architectural depth at outer perimeter only, not a perspective room with horizon. Production game background, not concept poster.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent pixel-art NPC sprite for a top-down roguelite. Original squat cube-shaped mechanical blacksmith, warm brass and dark steel body, square head with glowing amber eyes, leather apron, big hammer held at side and small anvil at feet. Facing down toward player in three-quarter top-down view, entire character and anvil visible with generous transparent margins. Crisp deliberate 64px-style pixel clusters enlarged, shaded metal outlines, no smooth illustration look. Isolated centered, no text, no letters, no floor tile, no shadow backdrop, no logo. Dark dungeon palette with amber highlights, readable silhouette. Genuine transparent background.
